purpose: Handle the one post-#1482 representative excluded from the cubic Gaussian adapter. The same Q(i) quotient is quartic in u, but its K-rational branch point u=0 permits the exact birational inversion s=1/u. After the square rescaling w=(1+i)*v/u^2 the quotient is cubic with rational leading coefficient, so the already-used elliptic-Chabauty rational-coordinate interface applies to s. This lock grants no closure credit.

exact_quartic_adapter.rationality_map: For a parent point with u != 0, s=1/u is rational and X=24960*s is rational. Elliptic Chabauty is therefore run against the X-coordinate map exactly as in the cubic adapter.
exact_quartic_adapter.reverse_filter: For finite rational X != 0, set s=X/24960 and u=1/s. A rational parent x exists only if u^2+4 is a rational square; then x=(u+-sqrt(u^2+4))/2. Exact-test every reconstructed x on C and against U/d1,V/d2,A/d3,B/d4.

exceptional_nonzero_u_exclusions.u_zero: u=0 gives x=+-1; U=0, hence receiver-degenerate.
exceptional_nonzero_u_exclusions.s_zero: s=0 is the u=infinity boundary of the inversion; the original quotient boundary comes from x=0 or x=infinity, where homogeneous V=0, hence receiver-degenerate. Do not treat X=0 as an affine reverse-reconstruction point.

magma_adapter.completion_gate: A diagnostic candidate requires exact rank/index evidence, 2-saturation where rank is one, elliptic-Chabauty completion with the odd-index/IndexBound=2 coprimality condition checked, exact reverse reconstruction, and zero nondegenerate full-parent lifts.

credit: Diagnostic only. A successful result must be frozen into a dedicated deterministic proof replay and then separately hostile-audited before authoritative promotion or sign-partner transfer.
